# references/external/

External reference material — standards, regulations, frameworks.

## Purpose

Long-lived external documents that inform refactor decisions but are not under the team's control: Vietnam Accounting Standards (VAS), banking regulations, e-invoice format specs, Spring Boot / Next.js upgrade notes, third-party library ADRs.

## What goes here

- One markdown per topic, with the source URL and the date last reviewed
- Pinned copies of public PDFs / specs (when permitted by licence)
